primary_decision.reason: none of five frozen causal bar-pattern detectors achieved 60-percent target-first precision, positive after-cost dynamic payoff, secure paired-control lift, cost survival, time stability, or leave-one-stock-out robustness in both periods

tested_detectors.note: best headline 2026 cell, but its lift interval crossed zero, Holm-adjusted p was 0.392, and 2025 reversed

tested_detectors.fixed_h24_guard: medians were negative, the 2026 trimmed mean was negative, both block intervals crossed zero widely, and structural failures remained negative at h24

path_findings: The detectors did not forecast favorable-before-adverse excursion ordering.
Tight H1/H5 risks created many unresolved five-minute dual touches, but wider and nearly ambiguity-free H2/H3 paths still failed.
Large full-window MFE did not imply a usable entry because MAE and invalidation often came first.
H5 target-first paths activated rapidly, but future success cannot be used as a causal admission filter.
H5 structural failures were still negative after 24 bars on average, so simply removing the stop is not supported.
retired_paths: the five exact V1 bar-pattern detector definitions on opened 2025 and partial 2026
tuning their bar, wick, range, activity, opening-range, cooldown, target, stop, or horizon thresholds on the opened outcomes
calling a high MFE or positive arithmetic h24 mean a profitable detector
using realised success, MFE, MAE, hit order, child, morph, loop, or regime outcome as a causal filter
optimising hit rate without risk-specific cost-adjusted expectancy and coverage

next_path.name: selective_alert_confirmation_admission_path
next_path.primary_rule: positive only when the conservative lower uncertainty bound of cost-adjusted expectancy exceeds zero
next_path.accuracy_reporting: precision jointly with coverage, calibration, support, and expected net bps
next_path.guard: confirmation levels, timing, risk, reward, and horizon cannot be selected from V1 outcomes
